independence.scope: Read the experiment brief, judge prompt, exact original and frozen target, approved native family visual/technical inputs and actual original Blender data. No editor proposal, sibling review or candidate aesthetic verdict was used.
independence.ownership: reviews/ only; source opened in a separate headless Blender process and changed in memory only for visibility, publisher-facing and rig evaluation. Original project bytes were not saved or replaced.

sourceObservations: The source snapshot is the horizontal presentation: coral rails run across the top and bottom, with slate-blue slat lines running vertically between the open left and right ends. Four-view original sheets confirm that N/S are horizontal presentations and E/W are vertical presentations.

The source has a clear simple conveyor identity and legible seven-period cadence, but rails read as flat rectangular color bands with abrupt top/front changes. Deck slats have narrow dark seams without the target's broader rounded shoulders.

The exposed legs are nearly black brown at normal logical size, so the support construction collapses into dark blocks. At cell32 the rail/deck palette remains recognizable, but the small dark feet convey little crafted form.

No ornamental part count is sacred. Better native support proportions, interior construction and useful fastener detail are welcome if the one-cell envelope, contact height, endpoints and family continuity remain correct.
targetObservations: The target retains the correct horizontal conveyor identity, top/bottom coral rails and vertical slate-blue slat boundaries. Broad coral highlights and darker lower faces communicate rounded volume; the blue deck has readable midtones and softened slat shoulders.

Honey-colored wood, restrained grain, darker foot pieces and small brass details give the support a purposeful crafted character. These are useful outcomes to reconstruct natively within the envelope, without requiring the exact target geometry or decoration placement.

The target's large brass collars wrap the ends of the top and bottom rails. They conflict with the flush modular end-profile contract and must not be copied onto the open joins. A target feature has no authority to enlarge or close a connector.

The target is larger than the native export and has its own padding and internal placement. It establishes aesthetic direction only; neither its canvas nor alpha silhouette proves registration, contact, height or seamless connections.

The approved N family native reference establishes the actual continuous coral/slate/honey palette, soft material response, native cut profiles, repeat and phase. W should belong visibly to that family rather than exaggerating the ImageGen target's gold collars or glare.

sourceComparativeScores.meaning: Descriptive baseline against this chosen warm soft cartoon direction; not a numerical approval threshold and not a verdict on an unseen candidate.

independentlyMeasuredNativeFacts.uvInterpretation: Actual Flow UV.x is incoming0 to outgoing1. At publisher S, UV.x0 is world(+0.5,0,.64) and UV.x1 is world(-0.5,0,.64). Shader graph computes FRACT(7*UV.x+phase). UV.y crosses the deck.

action.assignmentNote: Library stores the correct action but leaves it unassigned on load. The inspection explicitly assigns the rig-record material owner and slot in memory, then evaluates all25 phases. Flat unassigned load state is not the delivered animation contract.

camera.authority: inputs/source-camera.json; not the unrelated active35degree library camera

independentlyMeasuredNativeFacts.visibility: All collection, layer and object hide/exclude flags were cleared in headless memory; depsgraph updated before bounds, local/world vertices, UV endpoints and profiles were measured.
independentlyMeasuredNativeFacts.resources: Original library has no linked Blender libraries and two packed dish PNGs unrelated to this conveyor's procedural materials. Candidate resource dependency closure still requires its own audit.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: Clearly rounded coral rail and blue-slat volume, with broad restrained highlights and clean, continuous family shading in every orientation and frame.
Warm readable honey supports and purposeful interior crafted detail that survives intended sizes without becoming dark blocks or clutter.
Unbroken animated modular construction across native and independently assembled repeated and compatible mixed routes, including the actual filtered Godot presentation.

limits: This is the initial source/target review and proposed bar only. No candidate was inspected or approved.

The supplied original.png was verified RGBA-identical to actual production running-N atlas frame00. Four original frame sheets cover all96 unique exported frames; closure was verified through native action evaluation, not through an original closure PNG that was not supplied.
The use-size source sheet is a documented uniform Pillow downsample for baseline inspection. It is not a substitute for actual Godot consumer evidence required for a candidate.
The family receipt and native project/recipe/consumer file hashes were checked. Other judges' aesthetic conclusions were not read.
